SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 11.4.1 Spelling: Commonly Misspelt Words, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it difficult to spell and fingerspell some words correctly? 2. How can we become better at spelling and fingerspelling words?

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 11.4.1 Spelling: Commonly Misspelt Words together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

Critical thinking and problem solving: making connection as learner, in groups, make words from jumbled up letters.
